Daniel can foster skill practice in landscape photography by joining local photography clubs or online forums dedicated to the genre. Participating in group photo walks allows him to explore new locations and learn from peers' techniques. He should also engage in critique sessions where members provide constructive feedback on each other's work, helping him refine his technical skills and develop a unique style. Additionally, entering photography challenges or contests can motivate consistent practice and provide external validation.

The color of grass during summer is typically green.
